newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pakistan veg oil imports seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan veg oil imports seen rising.

text.p: Pakistan is expected to import 1.325 million tonnes of vegetable oils in 1996/97 and 1.35 million tonnes in 1997/98, an Indian industry official said on Wednesday.

"The demand is expected to rise in the near term by five to six percent annually," said G.K. Sood, chief executive of the Vanaspati Manufacturers' Association of India, which closely monitors the edible oil market in Pakistan.
Sood, speaking at a conference on vegetable oils, oilseeds and meals in Kuala Lumpur, said 85 percent of the imports will be made up of palm oil.
Pakistan imported 1.26 million tonnes of vegetable oils in 1995/96.
Sood said demand for vegetable oils in 1996/97 will be 1.75 million tonnes and 1.85 million tonnes in 1997/98.
"This year's domestic production of 425,000 tonnes will need to be topped up with 1.45 million tonnes of imports including industrial oils and tallow," he said.
